description: Re-inject essential context after context compaction (SessionStart, matcher compact: stdout is added to the context)

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context-essentials.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; else echo 'No .claude/context-essentials.md found. Create it with key architectural decisions, conventions and current tasks.'; fi; exit 0

sections: ## Current Tasks: What is being worked on

usage: Part of the default profile. Create .claude/context-essentials.md with the project's critical context that must survive compaction.
